definitions.explanation: Rainfall made unusually acidic by air pollution — primarily sulfur and nitrogen oxides from factories and vehicles. A common topic in environmental discussions.

examples.japanese: {酸性雨|さんせいう}が{森|もり}を{傷|いた}める。
{酸性雨|さんせいう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{湖|みずうみ}の{魚|さかな}が{減|へ}った。
examples.english: The fish in the lake decreased due to the effects of acid rain.

examples.japanese: {大気汚染|たいきおせん}が{進|すす}むと、{酸性雨|さんせいう}が{建物|たてもの}や{農作物|のうさくぶつ}にも{被害|ひがい}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: As air pollution advances, acid rain causes damage to buildings and crops as well.

notes:
Compound of {酸性|さんせい} (acidic) + {雨|あめ}/{雨|う} (rain). The reading う for {雨} appears in compound terms (cf. {梅雨|ばいう}, {豪雨|ごうう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酸性雨|さんせいう}が{降|ふ}る: acid rain falls
- {酸性雨|さんせいう}の{被害|ひがい}: damage from acid rain
- {酸性雨|さんせいう}{対策|たいさく}: countermeasures against acid rain
- {酸性雨|さんせいう}の{原因|げんいん}: the cause of acid rain

RELATED WORDS:
- {大気汚染|たいきおせん}: air pollution
- {環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}: environmental problems
